tools.name: typesense_get_health
tools.description: Check whether the Typesense server is ready to accept requests. Typesense API: GET /health.

tools.name: typesense_list_collections
tools.description: List all collections with their names, field schemas, document counts and default sorting field. Good first call to see what is searchable. Typesense API: GET /collections.

tools.name: typesense_get_collection
tools.description: Get one collection: its field schema, document count and settings. Typesense API: GET /collections/{collectionName}.

tools.name: typesense_search
tools.description: Search one collection with typo-tolerant full-text search, filters, sorting, facets and pagination. Returns hits, found count and facet counts. Typesense API: GET /collections/{collectionName}/documents/search.

tools.name: typesense_multi_search
tools.description: Run up to 10 searches in one request, each on its own collection, and return one result per search. Typesense API: POST /multi_search.

tools.name: typesense_get_document
tools.description: Get one document from a collection by its id. Typesense API: GET /collections/{collectionName}/documents/{documentId}.

tools.name: typesense_list_synonym_sets
tools.description: List all synonym sets (words treated as equal in search). Typesense API: GET /synonym_sets.

tools.name: typesense_get_synonym_set
tools.description: Get one synonym set and its items. Typesense API: GET /synonym_sets/{synonymSetName}.

tools.name: typesense_list_curation_sets
tools.description: List all curation sets (pinned and hidden results rules). Typesense API: GET /curation_sets.

tools.name: typesense_list_aliases
tools.description: List all collection aliases. An alias points to a collection, so an app can switch collections without a code change. Typesense API: GET /aliases.

tools.name: typesense_get_alias
tools.description: Get one alias and the collection it points to. Typesense API: GET /aliases/{aliasName}.

tools.name: typesense_list_analytics_rules
tools.description: List analytics rules that count searches or clicks into popular-query collections. Optionally filter by rule_tag. Typesense API: GET /analytics/rules.

tools.name: typesense_create_collection
tools.description: Create a new collection with a field schema. Fails with HTTP 409 if the name already exists. Writes data structure only: it stores no documents. Typesense API: POST /collections.

tools.name: typesense_upsert_document
tools.description: Create a document, or replace it when a document with the same id exists. The document must include its id, so a retry replaces the same document. Typesense API: POST /collections/{collectionName}/documents?action=upsert.

tools.name: typesense_update_document
tools.description: Change some fields of an existing document and keep the rest. Only the given fields change. Calling it twice with the same data gives the same result. Typesense API: PATCH /collections/{collectionName}/documents/{documentId}.

tools.name: typesense_delete_document
tools.description: Delete one document by id. This tool cannot restore a deleted document. Typesense API: DELETE /collections/{collectionName}/documents/{documentId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: typesense_multi_search · Private data: typesense_list_collections, typesense_get_collection, typesense_search, typesense_get_document, typesense_create_collection, typesense_upsert_document, typesense_update_document, typesense_delete_document · Public sink: typesense_multi_search, typesense_create_collection, typesense_upsert_document · Destructive: typesense_multi_search, typesense_delete_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: typesense_multi_search · Private data: typesense_list_collections, typesense_get_collection, typesense_search, typesense_get_document, typesense_create_collection, typesense_upsert_document, typesense_update_document, typesense_delete_document · Public sink: typesense_multi_search, typesense_create_collection, typesense_upsert_document · Destructive: typesense_multi_search, typesense_delete_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
